notes: בְּטַמְּאָם is divided under rules 52 and 18: *when* to the preposition, *defile* to the infinitive, *they* to its suffixed subject.
The waw before לֹא יָמֻתוּ takes the ASV's subordinating *that* (rules 14, 55), and the opening waw takes *Thus*.
The suffix on תוֹכָם is the nomen rectum and takes the whole *of them*, headed on the pronoun (rule 19).
